description: Send a task to an autonomous Claude Code agent. It reads/writes files, runs shell commands, searches codebases, and handles complex software engineering tasks end-to-end. Returns the result text plus a session_id for follow-ups via claude_code_reply.

additionalDirs.description: Extra directories the agent can access for this invocation

disallowedTools.description: Additional tools to block (unions with server-level blacklist)

permissionMode.description: Permission mode override (can only tighten, never loosen)

plugins.description: Additional plugin paths to load for this invocation (unions with server-level plugins)

prompt.description: Task or question for Claude Code

run_id.description: Workflow run ID — groups related agent calls into one timeline. Auto-generated if omitted; returned in every response for propagation.

systemPrompt.description: Additional system prompt (appended to server default)

tools.description: Restrict available tools to this list (intersects with server-level restriction)

name: claude_code
